card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that swells and shrinks every 20.8 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, V340 Ara: Per, Rad, Dist

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 99.1 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 3,712 parsecs away.
